crossRefs.note: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike…
for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: The king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, “Why have you done this thing and saved the boys alive?”
translations.bsb: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
translations.kjv: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
translations.asv: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men-children alive?
